title: Manufacturing Facility Verification and Compliance Procedures
summary: The regulatory approach to verifying manufacturing facilities has evolved from simple periodic inspections by local VAT officials to a more structured, multi-agency committee-based verification process. While the core requirement of physical site inspection remains, the documentation and oversight mechanisms have become more standardized and rigorous over time.

evolution.oversight_mechanism: Shifted from unilateral VAT department oversight to a multi-agency committee approach.
evolution.standardization: Moved from informal reporting to standardized, industry-specific inspection templates (Perishistha-1).

timeline.change: Established the initial requirement for periodic (6-month) physical inspection by local VAT officials to verify production compliance.
Formalized the inspection reporting structure with standardized templates (Perishistha-1) for specific industries like switches/sockets.
Introduced a multi-agency committee (Customs, VAT, and Ministry of Industry) for site verification and reporting prior to granting duty concessions.

Business Identification Number: The factory inspection report requires the mandatory inclusion of the Business Identification Number to identify the manufacturing facility.
Tax Identification Number: The factory inspection report requires the mandatory inclusion of the Tax Identification Number for the owner or proprietor of the manufacturing facility.
S.R.O. 120-AIN/2023: This order provides concessional import facilities for raw materials, parts, or equipment used in the local production of electrical components such as switches, sockets, lamp holders, dimmers, and plugs.
Manufacturing facilities must be verified and recommended for inclusion under this regulatory order to avail the permitted customs duty concessions.

Air Conditioner Manufacturing Industry: Manufacturing units must apply to the National Board of Revenue to receive concessional duty benefits on the import of raw materials and components.
Applicants are subject to an on-site inspection and verification process by a designated committee to confirm the status of their industrial operations before approval is granted.
Upon receiving approval, the entity must submit a copy of the authorization document with their bill of entry for each shipment during the customs clearance process.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authority responsible for reviewing and approving applications for concessional import facilities for air conditioner manufacturing industries.

A committee formed by the National Board of Revenue, including representatives from relevant VAT and industrial departments, oversees the physical inspection and verification of manufacturing facilities.

৯। উৎপাদনযোগ্য পণ্যের উপকরণ-উৎপাদ সহগ সংশ্লিষ্ট ভ্যাট কমিশনারেটে দাখিল ও অনুমোদন করা হইয়াছে কিনা :

উপর্যুক্ত তথ্যাদি পর্যালোচনায় প্রতীয়মান হয় যে, বর্ণিত প্রতিষ্ঠানটি স্থানীয়ভাবে রেফ্রিজারেটর ও ফ্রিজার উৎপাদনকারী/রেফ্রিজারেটর ও ফ্রিজার এর পার্টস উৎপাদনের লক্ষ্যে প্রাথমিক প্রস্তুতি সম্পন্ন করিয়াছে। প্রতিষ্ঠানটিকে প্রজ্ঞাপন এস.আর.ও. নং ১৯৪-আইন/২০২৪/৪৬/কাস্টমস, তারিখ: ২৯ মে, ২০২৪ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ এর আওতায় প্রজ্ঞাপনে উল্লিখিত পণ্য/যন্ত্রাংশ/উপকরণ রেয়াতি সুবিধায় আমদানির অনুমোদন প্রদানের সুপারিশ করা হইল এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানটিকে এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের উদ্দেশ্য পূরণকল্পে, রেফ্রিজারেটর ও ফ্রিজার উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান ক্যাটাগরি-১/রেফ্রিজারেটর ও ফ্রিজার উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান ক্যাটাগরি-২/ভেন্ডর হিসাবে তালিকাভুক্ত করা হইল।

সংশ্লিষ্ট ভ্যাট বিভাগীয় কর্মকর্তার নাম ও স্বাক্ষর
তারিখ:

শিল্প মন্ত্রণালয়ের প্রতিনিধির নাম ও স্বাক্ষর
তারিখ:

জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ডের প্রতিনিধির নাম ও স্বাক্ষর
তারিখ:

Business Identification Number: The factory inspection report requires the submission of the Business Identification Number to verify the industrial facility's registration status.
Tax Identification Number: The factory inspection report mandates the provision of the Tax Identification Number for the owner or proprietor of the industrial facility.
S.R.O. 194-AIN/2024: This notification provides the legal framework under which refrigerator and freezer manufacturing facilities or their parts manufacturers may be granted concessionary import benefits for raw materials and components.
The inspection report serves as the basis for recommending that a facility be granted import privileges under this notification upon being categorized as a qualified manufacturer or vendor.
National Board of Revenue: Representatives of the National Board of Revenue are required to certify and sign the factory inspection report to validate the findings and recommendations for concessionary benefits.

Business Identification Number: The factory inspection report requires the submission of the Business Identification Number to verify the registration status of the air conditioner manufacturing or assembly facility.
Tax Identification Number: The factory inspection report requires the provision of the Tax Identification Number as part of the formal documentation for industrial site verification.
S.R.O. 200-AIN/2022/108/CUSTOMS: This Statutory Regulatory Order provides the legal framework under which manufacturing facilities can be recommended for concessional import privileges for specified goods, parts, or raw materials used in air conditioner production.
Value Added Tax: The inspection process confirms whether the manufacturing facility has submitted and obtained approval for their input-output coefficients from the relevant Value Added Tax Commissionerate.
